verifications.claim: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket is scheduled to launch 29 Starlink satellites on Sunday, March 29, 2026, from Cape Canaveral, FL.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R3: 'SpaceX Starlink 10-44 Mission: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket will launch 29 Starlink satellites ... Launch window: 5:15 p.m. to 9:15 p.m. ET on Sunday, March 29. ... Location: Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.' R4: 'This SpaceX rocket launch from Florida has been postponed until the afternoon of Monday, March 30.'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly supports the claim including date, rocket, satellites, and location; R4 contradicts by stating the launch was postponed to March 30.
